term: All India Muslim Personal Law Board

field_meaning.hi: All India Muslim Personal Law Board, मुस्लिम संगठन।

review_objections: Alibaba: Hindi meaning is a meta-statement ('AIMPLB, Muslim organization') rather than a proper definition. Also, it is an organization, not a legal term.
